description: Create a new outreach campaign with target audience, messaging template, and schedule configuration. Requires a Pro or Business plan.

deadline.description: Campaign deadline in ISO 8601 date format (e.g., '2025-12-31')

description.description: Campaign description shown in the marketplace listing

guidelines.description: Instructions and guidelines for campaign participants

message.description: The WhatsApp message template to send to contacts

requireMutualContact.description: Only allow sends to contacts who have previously responded (default: false)

rewardPerDelivery.description: Reward per successful delivery in kobo (e.g., 5000 = NGN 50)

title.description: Campaign title displayed in marketplace and dashboard

totalBudget.description: Total campaign budget in kobo (e.g., 500000 = NGN 5,000)

title: Create Campaign
